optimization.action_description: Episode 133 candidate: q4 warp-group register-reconfiguration enablement in gqa_decode_paged.py (ONLY file changed, 39+/3-; q1/atomic-q1 binaries byte-identical). ROOT CAUSE found via the first NCU mainloop deep-dive of the campaign (diagnostic flagged untested-after-13-episodes): the correction warpgroup spilled ~188MB/launch of local memory in the per-iteration s-loop (99.7pct of ALL L1TEX sectors, 690,592 spill requests/launch, L1TEX 92pct vs DRAM 51pct) because use_reg_reconfig = blk_tile_h > 16 is permanently False at the production grouped_head_tile=16, pinning all 384 threads to uniform 168 registers while the correction tail (tOrO_tail 256 f32) needs its designed 256. FIX (landed): gate reconfiguration on blk_tile_n > 16 (the canonical non-paged decoder semantics = exactly the q4-shaped tiles): mma/tma warpgroup decreases to 64, the single softmax warpgroup KEEPS the 168-register launch allocation (designed 120 spills the 64-wide q4 S/P chains: measured -28pct at b1 q4; a 192 increase needs (64+192+256)*128=65536 > CTA pool 64512 and DEADLOCKS setmaxnreg.inc: measured hang), correction increases to 256. NCU after: 0 spills, 0 LDL/STL, bitwise-identical outputs. EVIDENCE (gateway sm_103 L20D prod, same-process same-allocation ABBA): landed-vs-pristine hot geomean +2.2pct on mandated/guard q4 cells (a_b11_q4 +1.6 hot/+2.3 cold, b_b5_q4 +2.0/+1.6, c_b16_q4 +3.0, mix_b8_q4 +0.6, g_b1_q4 +3.8/+2.7), mid-band q4 +3.9..+5.5pct (m_b12_q4_48k, m_b16_q4_64k), q1 controls neutral/byte-identical, atomic-q4 +0.2..0.3, none +0.1, kernel-4 +0.45 - zero regressions on any of 21 ABBA cells. CORRECTNESS: 85/85 full-domain PASS on the landed source (none/atomic/kernel modes, q1+q4, edges 1..131072, e4m3+e5m2, permuted/padded block tables, mandated (a)/(b)/(c)+mixed+guards; worst rel_l2 0.0060 vs 0.05 gate, 0 mismatches, native-launcher replays bitwise-stable). STRESS: 7000 async launches across early-exit/deep-k32-k64/two-wave-k9/compact-k8/cluster-2..16/PDL configs: 0 faults. SIDE FINDINGS closing old directions: q4 y-twin KV double-read is FULLY L2-deduped (dram read == exact single-read 671.7MB floor) so multicast saves zero DRAM traffic; p_stages=5 regresses (0.96, kv_stages loss); reduction geometry vec4/vec8/half-block null-or-worse (current 128thr/vec2 optimal); q4 seq_len<q_len hang is pre-existing on pristine and generator-excluded (invalid domain).

experiments.name: ncu_first_mainloop_deep_dive_a_b11_q4
experiments.hypothesis: The 13-episode-untested NCU mainloop diagnostic will localize the structural residual (big mandated cells at 1.24-1.45x aggregate-bandwidth floor).
experiments.change: Built profiles/e0133 harness (cases.py mandated cells, probe.py device decomposition, ncu_run.sh sections+raw-metrics). NCU --set full on a_b11_q4 (b11 q4 113k-126k agg 1.31M, compact k8, grid 8x2x11) decode+reduction. Baselines this pod: a_b11_q4 hot 131.6us total; b_b5_q4 decode 57.5us + reduction 5.7us = 63.2us device.
experiments.evidence: DECODE: dram__bytes_read.sum=671.7MB == exact single-read KV floor (512B/tok x 1.31M) -> q4 grid_y double-read FULLY L2-deduped (lts hit 37.5pct); multicast saves zero DRAM traffic (explains e116 mcast lottery). DRAM 51.5pct (3.95TB/s at NCU clocks) while L1/TEX throughput 92.2pct -> L1TEX pipe is the bottleneck. Cause: local memory = 99.69pct of ALL L1TEX sectors; local ld 2.94M + st 2.93M sectors (~188MB/launch); Local Memory Spilling Requests 690592 (overhead 100pct); LDL/STL 84.9/86.8pct of local ops; stack 1024B; regs/thread 168 uniform; tensor pipe 36.9pct; warp cycles/inst 6.27; sched issues every 2.1 cycles. Spill traffic scales with iters_s (~18KB/CTA-iter) -> hot-loop spilling. REDUCTION kernel: 8.6us NCU-serialized, 4.4MB dram, negligible. CODE INSIGHT: use_reg_reconfig = blk_tile_h > 16 is ALWAYS FALSE (grouped_head_tile=16) -> designed setmaxnreg redistribution (mma/tma 64, softmax 120, correction 256; asserted to fit 64K) never runs; all 384 threads share uniform 168 regs; correction wg (tOrO_tail 256 f32 frags) and softmax (64-wide scores/probs chains) exceed budget.
experiments.result: Root cause of the mainloop streaming residual localized: register spilling in the q4 decode hot loop because warp-group register reconfiguration is disabled by a vestigial gate. Next: SASS attribution of LDL/STL to warp roles, then enable/retune reconfig and measure.

experiments.name: reg_reconfig_variant_abba_v1_v2
experiments.hypothesis: Enabling the vestigial warp-group register reconfiguration (use_reg_reconfig = blk_tile_h > 16 is always False at grouped_head_tile=16) removes the correction-warpgroup hot-loop spills and speeds up the decode kernel. V1 = designed constants (mma/tma 64, softmax 120, correction 256/208). V2 = q4 softmax keeps launch budget 168 (no dec call; 120 is too small for the 64-wide q4 S/P fragment chains), correction incs to 256; q1 keeps designed exact-fit.
experiments.change: profiles/e0133/mkvariant.py builds patched package copies in /tmp imported as second module in one process; abba.py same-process same-allocation ABBA (2 rounds A,B,B,A hot + B,A,A,B cold-L2 w/ 256MB flush, event medians, bitwise + fp32-reference checks).
experiments.evidence: SASS attribution (NCU source page, a_b11_q4 decode): hottest LDL.LU.64/STL lines (20,016 exec = per-CTA-per-iter, 2x-unrolled) sit interleaved with SHFL.IDX x32 / FMUL2.F32x2 / LDTM.x32 / STTM.x32 = the CORRECTION warpgroup s-loop; softmax-region lines (40,896 exec) show no spill in top-14. V1 ABBA: g_b1_q4 -28pct (softmax-120 spills the q4 chains badly), g_b1_q1 +0.8pct. V2 ABBA (all bitwise-identical outputs): a_b11_q4 hot +1.92pct cold +1.51; b_b5_q4 hot +1.22 cold +2.39; c_b16_q4 hot +1.83 cold 0.00; mix_b8_q4 hot +2.47 cold -0.05; g_b1_q4 hot +3.47 cold +0.15. V1 on q1 cells: b_b5_q1 +0.51 hot (atomic, relL2 6.1e-3 PASS ref), c_b16_q1 +0.48, c_b15_q1 -0.35, mix_b8_q1 -1.4 hot/+0.1 cold (noisy) - q1 near-neutral.
experiments.result: V2 (reconfig with q4 softmax at launch budget) is a safe uniform q4 win: hot +1.2..3.5pct on every q4 cell incl. all mandated, bitwise-identical outputs, zero regressions. Gain smaller than spill volume suggests -> residual limiter is not only local-memory traffic; q1 benefits little from the designed 120/208 split. Next: NCU the V2 binary for the post-fix limiter (stall attribution: top-2 rows are mbarrier PHASECHK.TRYWAIT = pipeline waits) and test V3 (softmax inc 192, exact-fit 512 pool).

experiments.name: variant_sweep_and_landing_v5_reconfig
experiments.hypothesis: With spills localized to the correction warpgroup, a pool-feasible register split removes them; deeper P/S pipelining or reduction-geometry changes may stack on top.
experiments.change: Swept: v5 = reconfig gated blk_tile_n>16 (swg==1), mma/tma dec 64, softmax STAYS at launch 168 (no call), correction inc 256; p5 = p_stages 4->5 (s_stages 5, kv_stages 8); r1/r2/r3 = reduction vec4/vec8/half-d-block geometries. NCU on V2/V5 binary; ABBA same-process same-allocation on mandated + mid-band + atomic/none + guard cells.
experiments.evidence: V3 (softmax inc 192) DEADLOCKS: setmaxnreg pool = launch_regs*threads = 168*384 = 64512 < (64+192+256)*128 = 65536 -> inc blocks forever (job killed at 600s); feasibility requires launch >= 160 for the (64,168,256) split - launch is 168 (NCU). V5/V2 ABBA q4: a_b11_q4 hot +1.9..2.65pct cold +0.7..1.5; b_b5_q4 +0.3..1.2 hot/+2.4 cold; c_b16_q4 +1.7..1.8 hot; mix_b8_q4 +1.2..2.5 hot; g_b1_q4 +3.5..4.3 hot; m_b12_q4_48k +5.4 hot; m_b16_q4_64k +3.5 hot/+1.8 cold; m_b6_q4_8k +2.3 hot; ALL bitwise-identical. Small/mode coverage: m_b16_q4_8k(atomic-4) +0.34, m_b2_q4_2k(atomic-8) +0.18, m_b1_q4_256(none) +0.12 bitwise, m_b17_q4_8k(kernel-4) +0.45 - no regressions. q1 cells: binaries byte-identical under the blk_tile_n>16 gate (c_b16_q1/g_b1_q1 bitwise=True, +-0.5pct noise; atomic q1 drift-only ref PASS). V5 NCU (a_b11_q4 decode): Local Memory Spilling Requests 690592 -> 0; LDL/STL dynamic 0; L1/TEX hit 98->22pct (local traffic gone); duration ~unchanged under NCU clocks; L1TEX STILL 92pct and DRAM 51.7pct -> residual L1TEX load is STRUCTURAL smem port traffic (TMA writes 128KB + UMMA operand reads ~160KB per CTA-iter); dynamic opcode mix now F2FP 11.5pct FMUL2 8.4 MUFU 7.0 HADD2 6.8 (softmax cvt/exp2 chain), tensor pipe 36.9pct. p5: 0.96 (kv_stages loss dominates) - CLOSED. r1 vec4: 1.001 null; r2 vec8: 0.97; r3 half-block: 0.99 - reduction geometry (128thr,vec2) already optimal - CLOSED. Corpus check: canonical NON-paged gqa_decode.py gates reconfig on blk_tile_n>16 (ENABLED for q4-shaped tiles, softmax dec 120 with TWO softmax wgs); canonical paged file has the same dormant blk_tile_h>16 gate as vendored - the landed (64,168-stay,256) split is the episode-calibrated working point for the single-softmax-wg paged q4 kernel.
experiments.result: LANDED in vendor gqa_decode_paged.py (39+/3-): use_reg_reconfig = blk_tile_n > 16; softmax_regs = 168 under the gate (no decrease call there); correction increases to 256 funded by the mma/tma decrease to 64. q1 binaries byte-identical; q4 kernel/atomic/none modes all validated bitwise + no-regression. Full-domain correctness sweep (S1a..S8) and async-launch stress in progress on the landed source.

Kernel-mode replay bitwise-stable everywhere; atomic cells show only the pre-existing bf16 ordering drift (also on pristine configs). INVALID-DOMAIN probe: q4 seq_len=1 (< q_len, generator-excluded by contract ValueError) HANGS IDENTICALLY on pristine HEAD and landed source (240s timeout both) - pre-existing out-of-domain artifact, NOT a regression, unreachable from the evaluator input generator. Ready to finalize candidate_ready.

open_directions.direction: Post-spill limiter is STRUCTURAL smem-port traffic (L1TEX still 92pct with 0 spills: TMA writes 128KB + UMMA K/V/Q/P operand reads ~160KB per CTA-iter vs DRAM 51pct, SM issue 74pct, tensor pipe 37pct): the N=64 single-twin tile that would halve per-box smem traffic is double-blocked - tmem (s_stages collapses to 1) and the 640-thread register pool (softmax 128-f32 S fragments + 256-wide correction tail); 2SM UMMA across the y-pair is infeasible (twins hold different Q/B operands). Any future attempt must first restructure S/O fragment residency (e.g. chunked softmax halves, o_stages=1) to free tmem+regs.

Softmax instruction stream is the co-limiter after spills: F2FP 11.5pct + HADD2 6.8pct + PRMT 4.7pct (P leading+residual fp8 pack/convert chains) + MUFU 7.0pct (exp2) + CREDUX 3.4pct (colmax) of 38.3M dynamic insts per a-cell launch; explore cheaper fp8 pack paths, packed f32x2 reductions, and trimming the residual-convert chain without touching the precision anchor.

q1 register reconfiguration (designed exact-fit 64/120/120/208, currently left OFF so q1 binaries stay byte-identical): measured near-neutral (+0.8pct g_b1_q1, +0.5 c_b16_q1/b_b5_q1, -1.4 noisy draw mix_b8_q1 k32) - retest with longer rounds before considering; the q1 1.26us/iter mainloop chain remains unexplained (NCU a q1 kernel-mode cell next).

Reduction kernel: geometry closed this episode (r1 vec4 null, r2 vec8 0.97, r3 half-block 0.99); its 4-6us is PDL-wait+ramp and effectively serial after decode (kineto sum == hot event total on b_b5_q4) - only pass-removal (closed v52) or cheaper decode-side epilogue publication remain.

Multicast direction is permanently closed on DRAM grounds: the y-twin double-read never reaches DRAM (L2 hit supplies the twin; dram__bytes_read == single-read floor exactly) - mcast would only save L2 bandwidth, consistent with the e116/e121/e122 pod-lottery history; do not re-attempt for traffic reasons.
